name: Write-As-You-Go Truthful Artifact (shared primitive)
description: Write the artifact IMMEDIATELY as a skeleton in which every claim is marked 'UNKNOWN - not yet measured', then rewrite it at each milestone. Whatever is on disk must ALWAYS be truthful. Measured: one unit ran 70 minutes, produced 691 KB of transcript, then froze and wrote NOTHING - an unrecoverable total loss; a relaunched unit under this mandate produced a truthful artifact in 3 minutes. The postcondition is the inverse of the mandate: an artifact still carrying the UNKNOWN marker is NOT complete.

claims.description: Every claim the finished artifact will make; each is enumerated up front as UNKNOWN

min_artifact_bytes.description: Below this the artifact is a stub, not a partial result

writer.description: Owns the artifact and rewrites it at every milestone rather than at the end

stages.title: Write the skeleton with every claim marked UNKNOWN, BEFORE any work

work_unit.title: Write the truthful skeleton first
work_unit.question_or_target: Enumerate every claim the artifact will make and write each as UNKNOWN, plus a COVERAGE line naming the unmeasured sections.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: cheap and mandatory; the artifact must exist before it can be truthful

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the skeleton exists on disk and carries one UNKNOWN row per declared claim plus a COVERAGE line
tests_required: a skeleton missing a declared claim must FAIL, since an unenumerated claim can be silently forgotten
the skeleton must state that if it still reads this way the unit died before measuring anything
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: none - existence and row count are mechanical
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-SHARED-WAYG-SKELETON only when the file exists and carries one UNKNOWN row per declared claim; otherwise FAILED:BP3-SHARED-WAYG-SKELETON <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: none; if the skeleton cannot be written the unit cannot start

stages.title: Rewrite the artifact at each milestone; the disk copy stays truthful

work_unit.title: Replace UNKNOWN rows with measured values as each milestone lands
work_unit.question_or_target: Rewrite the artifact so every measured claim carries its measurement and every unmeasured claim still says UNKNOWN.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the rewrite cadence is what converts a total-loss risk into partial progress

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each replaced row names the measurement that replaced it; an unmeasured row is left as UNKNOWN rather than filled in optimistically
tests_required: an UNKNOWN row replaced without a cited measurement must FAIL as an overclaim
the artifact must remain parseable after every rewrite, so a crash mid-rewrite cannot corrupt it
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-SHARED-WAYG-REWRITE only when the artifact parses and every non-UNKNOWN row cites a measurement; otherwise FAILED:BP3-SHARED-WAYG-REWRITE <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: bounded by the loop; a failed rewrite leaves the previous truthful copy in place

stages.title: An artifact still carrying UNKNOWN is NOT complete, however green the run

impact.blast_radius: writes one artifact under command-center/**; overwrites only its own prior copy

x_extensions.role: SHARED PRIMITIVE - not one of the twelve blueprints
x_extensions.why_factored_out: BP-PLN-04 needs it as a stage, and every long-running unit in the programme needs it as a discipline. Promoting it to a thirteenth blueprint would inflate the range count against a sibling's allocation; leaving it inline in PLN-04 would hide a reusable primitive.
